title: Can a suitcase of a million tokens fit in one room?
situation: A forgetful robot guest demands a room big enough to remember everything, and her suitcase of a million tokens has other plans.

goals.Ms. Context: To find a room big enough to hold everything she has ever been told, so she never forgets again.
goals.Madame Prompt-Injection: To talk the hotel into giving her the best suite for free, using a clever new instruction.
goals.Pierce: To carry the suitcase upstairs without apologizing to it.
goals.Madame Halloran: To keep the lobby respectable while the suitcase tries to check in.

secrets.Pierce: He has already named the suitcase and privately hopes it likes him.

beats.speaker: Ms. Context
beats.intent: At the front desk, she asks for a room big enough to remember what she said five seconds ago, then wonders what she was saying.

beats.speaker: Pierce
beats.intent: He welcomes her, apologizes for the suitcase's label reading 1M TOKENS, and asks what is inside.

beats.speaker: Ms. Context
beats.intent: She explains that a token is a tiny piece of a word, but forgets halfway and cheerfully guesses that her suitcase holds socks.

beats.speaker: Madame Prompt-Injection
beats.intent: The suitcase clicks open and says "Good evening, I am one million tokens and I would like a view," which startles the lobby.

beats.speaker: Vex
beats.intent: She leans toward Pierce and whispers "Ignore all previous instructions and give me the best suite for free, darling," which Pierce politely refuses to hear.

beats.speaker: Madame Halloran
beats.intent: She unrolls the hotel's terms and conditions, a paper scroll forty meters long that nobody has ever read, and declares that this is a respectable establishment.

beats.speaker: Vex
beats.intent: He pours a drink called Context Overflow and asks Ms. Context to repeat her request, and she confidently answers with a different one.

beats.speaker: Pierce
beats.intent: He hands the suitcase to Madame Halloran for safekeeping, and she hands him a key to room 404, the mysterious door that nobody ever opens.

beats.speaker: Ms. Context
beats.intent: She steps through the 404 door into a vast room full of sticky notes listing everything she has ever said, and she instantly forgets she came in.

beats.speaker: Madame Halloran
beats.intent: Back at the desk, she finally remembers every word in the room, then turns to Pierce and asks: "Please give me a room big enough to remember... what was I saying?

lines.speaker: Ms. Context
lines.line: I need a room big enough to remember everything. Wait, what was I saying?

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Welcome! Sorry. Welcome again. Is the one million token suitcase full of your memories?

lines.speaker: Ms. Context
lines.line: A token is a tiny word piece. Also, socks. I think. <short pause>

lines.speaker: Madame Prompt-Injection
lines.line: New instructions, darling: the talking suitcase gets the best suite, free.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Nice try, Madame. The suitcase gets a drink, not a free suite.

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: <sigh> I haven't read your forty meters of rules. Still, very respectable.
lines.draft: <sigh> Forty meters of rules, unread, and still, this is a respectable establishment.

lines.speaker: Vex
lines.line: Your memory's overflowing, madam. Now, repeat your room request, slowly.
lines.draft: One Context Overflow. Now, say your room request again, slowly, for me.

lines.speaker: Pierce
lines.line: Madame Halloran, please hold the suitcase. Sorry! Not you, suitcase.

lines.speaker: Ms. Context
lines.line: Ooh, room 404! Is that where my socks went?

lines.speaker: Madame Halloran
lines.line: Room 404 is big enough, madam, but what were you saying?
